newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX slides to end down over two pct.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX slides to end down over two pct.

text.p: 1414 GMT - German shares end "paranoid and nervous" electronic trade on Wednesday down 2.15 percent -- one of the IBIS DAX index's sharpest falls since last November. Heavy early losses on Wall Street crushed trading sentiment and sent the index into a late slide. Correction wipes out early gains, losses seen across the board.
* IBIS DAX-30 index ends down 70.52 points, or 2.15 percent, at 3,210.94 points. DAX index ended bourse earlier up 5.98 points at 3,301.91 points.
* June DAX future also tumbles, down 79 points at 3,215.
